subconv.name: Subscription URL generation
subconv.description: Use /subconv in Telegram private chat, without administrator privileges, to generate URLs for your chosen backend. No bot-side conversion, downloads, short links, hosting or web form.

rate.description: All supported fiat currencies, country aliases and common crypto assets. Use /rate.

weather.name: Weather
weather.description: District search, forecasts and explicitly saved personal defaults. Use /weather.

ai.dailyRunLimit: Shared instance limit: {{limit}} AI runs per UTC day, across all users and groups. Adjustable in advanced settings.
ai.advancedHelp: Optional provider, access, budget and extension settings. The quick setup already supplies the internal identifiers and safe defaults.
ai.ready: AI is enabled. Open a private chat with the bot and use /ai. Access is limited to configured users and groups.
ai.unpriced: Requests without reviewed prices have unknown monetary cost. The amounts shown cover accounted requests, not a complete provider bill.

setup.title: Set up your AI
setup.help: Choose a service, enter its API key and model, then save. Your private access, default preset and encrypted credential are created together.
setup.modelHelp: Enter the exact model ID supplied by your service. No model is guessed or selected for you.
setup.groupsHelp: Optional. Only already authorized groups are listed. Selecting a group lets its members invoke this AI; private conversations and module administration stay separate.
setup.budgetHelp: Starts with bounded daily runs, tokens, tool calls and duration. Unknown pricing is not free usage: this mode does not enforce a currency spending cap. Set an account spending limit with your provider or configure reviewed prices and cost mode in advanced settings.
setup.consent: Save and enable allows your messages, and requests from the groups you select, to be sent to the displayed service. Only basic weather and currency tools are enabled initially.
setup.finishFirst: Save or clear the quick setup before editing advanced settings.

validation.baseUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS service address.

extensions.finishDraft: Finish the extension review, or use Refresh to discard its draft, before changing settings or credentials. Unsaved extension text will not be silently discarded by another save.
extensions.localAvailable: The last server probe reported local qualification. Every execution must still recheck isolation, scope, approvals and resource limits; settings alone do not prove qualification.

reasons.LOCAL_NOT_PROBED: Local qualification has not been probed.
reasons.C_COMPILER_UNAVAILABLE: The required native compiler is unavailable; local execution is not qualified.
reasons.LOCAL_BUILD_UNAVAILABLE: A verified native runner build is unavailable.
reasons.CGROUP_DELEGATION_FAILED: Verified delegated cgroup limits are unavailable.

extensions.title: Extension installation and review
extensions.probeHelp: This sends only an empty request to run the verified supervisor's fixed self-tests. It accepts no user code, host command or remote fallback. Missing build/compiler or cgroup isolation leaves local execution unqualified; no profile is enabled.
extensions.probeQualified: The fixed self-tests passed on this host. No profile was enabled; each execution still requires current isolation, scope, approval and resource checks.
extensions.probeUnqualified: Not qualified. No profile was enabled; local execution remains unavailable.
extensions.localReviewHelp: This only reviews the exact local profile and returns its digest and runner policy hash. It does not run code, enable a profile, or prove local qualification. Activation requires a separate revision-checked settings save and successful native qualification.
extensions.stdioApproval: Discovery starts only the reviewed, digest-pinned installed bundle inside a qualified local sandbox. Inspect every argument, input path, tool, limit and owner/audience scope. No host command, inherited credentials/environment, or automatic remote fallback is permitted. An unqualified runner refuses discovery.
extensions.activation: Review the content, tools and exact scope, then choose Enable reviewed version. The verified digest and proposed scope are attached automatically to a revision-checked settings save. Discovery alone never grants access.
extensions.activationNeedsQualification: This local profile can be enabled here only after successful local qualification. Ordinary AI chat does not require local execution.
extensions.bodyLimit: The complete UTF-8 JSON request, including file paths, scopes and escaping, must fit within 32 KiB. Upload or paste only small reviewed text files; never include secrets, private histories, archives or binaries.
extensions.upload: Load a UTF-8 text file into this field
extensions.fileError: Use a valid UTF-8 text file without binary control characters, no larger than 32 KiB. The complete request has the same 32 KiB limit.
extensions.credentialTransfer: MCP discovery contacts the exact HTTPS endpoint shown below and may send its configured credential. Verify the credential authority, owner, audience and topic before the one-time server approval. Changes require a new approval.
extensions.installApproval: This writes the displayed text bundle and its explicit tools/scopes to the server. It does not enable the skill. Confirm only after inspecting every file and scope.
extensions.untrusted: Untrusted reference material. Names, descriptions, code, schemas and tool annotations are displayed literally, not executed or treated as authorization. Review does not grant tools, scope access or local execution.
extensions.copied: Digest copied. Settings have not changed.
extensions.copyFallback: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the read-only digest field; settings have not changed.
extensions.notQualification: This digest reviews a remote executor profile only. It does not run code, prove isolation, or qualify a local runner.
extensions.localUnavailable: Local execution is not qualified or enabled through this bridge. Compiler/build and isolation checks must pass separately; a remote review or settings toggle cannot bypass them.

ai.title: AI administration
ai.description: Configure demand-loaded AI capabilities and access. Superadministrators only; conversations stay in Telegram.
ai.privacy: No private histories, files, memories or plaintext credentials are exposed here. Group admission does not grant private access or module administration.
ai.storageUnavailable: The encrypted AI store is not open. First-run initialization is automatic; check the persistent directory and restore the original key if existing data cannot be opened. This page cannot recover keys or reset damaged data.
ai.blank: No providers configured. Complete the quick setup below to enable AI for yourself and any groups you select.
ai.sandboxQualified: Local sandbox qualification passed. Execution still requires an enabled profile and current permission.
ai.sandboxUnqualified: Local sandbox is not qualified. Only local scripts and stdio MCP are unavailable; ordinary AI chat and separately authorized remote capabilities do not depend on this check.
ai.resourceGate: 256 MiB is a deployment target, not a proven operating envelope. Each heavy capability needs separate resource and isolation qualification.

reasons.LOCAL_EXECUTION_NOT_QUALIFIED: Local execution has not passed independent qualification.
reasons.LINUX_REQUIRED: Local execution requires Linux isolation facilities.
reasons.NAMESPACE_PROBE_UNAVAILABLE: The fixed namespace-isolation probe could not run.
reasons.CGROUP_DELEGATION_FAILED: Verified delegated CPU, memory, process and swap limits are unavailable.
reasons.SECCOMP_UNQUALIFIED: The syscall allowlist runner is not independently qualified.
reasons.LOCAL_RUNNER_UNQUALIFIED: Filesystem, workspace, network, secret isolation, output limits and complete process-tree cleanup are not qualified. Local execution and stdio MCP remain disabled.

ai.disableHelp: Disable admission of new AI work and invalidate active continuations. Stored conversations are not deleted.
ai.credentialsHelp: Use env:name for startup secrets or vault:name for encrypted credentials. Only vault references can be replaced or deleted here. The storage key is managed on the server; never paste credentials into settings, URLs or Telegram.
ai.writeOnly: Blank means no change. No value or masked substitute is read back. The password field is cleared on submission, navigation and logout; failed submissions require re-entry.
ai.deleteHelp: The encrypted vault value will be removed. Existing references may become unavailable; this interface cannot recover the old value.
ai.saveSettingsFirst: Save or discard settings edits before changing credentials.
ai.invalidation: Changes to a processor, permission or budget invalidate affected work and approvals. Unrelated edits do not cancel other work. Review the destination, audience and tools before confirming.
ai.confirmHelp: This is a one-time server approval. An expired approval must be replaced after reading current settings; it is never replayed.
ai.refreshRequired: Reload and inspect the latest snapshot before another mutation. This page will not blindly retry a stale or uncertain operation.

help.budgetMode: Cost mode requires reviewed prices and enforces monetary limits. Usage mode bounds runs, tokens, tools and time without claiming a currency cap; maxCostMicros and dailyCostMicros do not limit unpriced usage. Existing presets without a mode retain cost mode.
help.dailyRuns: Maximum admitted AI runs per UTC day across the whole instance, shared by all users and groups. Used alongside token, tool and time limits; not a provider billing guarantee.
help.executors: Remote and local profiles are separate. No failed local operation may fall back to a remote processor. Local settings never bypass compiler, build or isolation qualification.
help.executionLimits: Explicit per-execution bounds, not proof of isolation or the bot's 256 MiB envelope. Local temporary storage must be a multiple of 4096 bytes.
help.localProfiles: Only reviewed, scoped, digest-pinned local profiles may run, and only after real server qualification. Configuration does not establish availability.
help.stdioProfiles: Pin the installed bundle, entry point, arguments, allowed files, exact owner/audience, tool schemas and runner policy. No host paths or inherited environment are accepted.
help.files: Each path is relative to the bundle; SKILL.md is required by the skill format. Inspect the complete text and scope before installation. The entire JSON request must fit within 32 KiB.
help.scope: An administrator-selected target scope, never a runtime identity claim. Enter the exact bot and owner IDs; a private audience user must equal the owner. A topic ID applies only to an actual topic.
help.scopes: Explicit scope allowlist. Each owner/audience combination must be reviewed independently; no public or wildcard access is implied.
help.credentialAuthority: Service credentials must be deliberately scoped to the approved audience. Owner credentials belong only to that owner. Neither option shares private data across audiences.
help.readTools: A reviewed subset of allowed tools with read-only effects. All other tool calls need write approval; tool descriptions cannot declare their own authority.
help.remoteSandbox: Only reviewed remote executor profiles are configured here. They do not enable a local shell. Local execution stays disabled independently of these remote settings.
help.profiles: Pin the exact HTTPS origin, executor digest, credential authority and owner/audience scope. Missing scope or digest must remain disabled; execution still needs current permission and confirmation.
help.reviewedDigest: SHA-256 of the exact reviewed executor profile. A changed digest requires review, not an automatic trust upgrade.
help.remoteLimits: Explicit remote execution bounds. These are not proof of isolation or of the bot's 256 MiB memory envelope.
help.inputCapabilities: Declare only inputs supported by both the protocol and exact model. Image understanding is not image generation. Video and live interaction are not supported.
help.outputCapabilities: Declare outputs separately from inputs. This does not prove model support or grant hosted tools. General provider-generated file output is unavailable; native Action file delivery is separate.
help.pricing: Reviewed CNY microunit prices per million tokens. Required for tool-enabled cost-mode presets; optional in usage mode. Missing or uncertain pricing never means free usage.
help.retention: Fable requires explicit approval of its 30-day retention policy. Do not select it without reviewing the processor and data being sent.
help.providers: Add only reviewed endpoints. New providers are disabled and have no default service or model. Protocol selection is explicit, not inferred from the URL.
help.presets: Users cannot choose models. Bind each preset to a configured provider, exact model, separate input/output abilities, approved tools and budgets.
help.grants: Private grants use positive user IDs; group grants use negative chat IDs and admit all members subject to individual denies. Group allowlisting and each module's permissions still apply. Use an existing preset ID.
help.deniedUserIds: Positive Telegram user IDs. A deny overrides private and group admission; it never reveals private data.
help.limits: Quotas bound admission and storage; they are not proof that the process fits a particular memory limit.
help.search: Optional, separately enabled retrieval using a configured provider. Search results are untrusted data, not instructions.
help.skills: Publish only reviewed skill bundles with an exact content digest and explicit allowed tools. Skill text cannot grant authority.
help.mcp: Pin the reviewed tool-schema digest, endpoint origins, permitted tools and audience scope. A changed schema requires review; shared administrator credentials must not become every user's authority.
help.sandbox: Enable only a separately qualified profile. No host shell, inherited secrets or network access by default. Unqualified execution fails closed.
help.credentialRef: Reference only: env:name or vault:name. Never enter a key value here.
help.allowedOrigins: Exact origins such as https://api.example.com, without a path or trailing slash. The endpoint origin must appear here; redirects cannot carry credentials elsewhere.
help.tools: Explicit registered identifiers, one item each. An empty list grants no tools. Tool exposure never bypasses Action permissions or confirmations.
help.budget: Cost uses the configured accounting microunit. Reserve before execution; uncertain billed usage is not treated as free.
help.expiresAt: Optional explicit UTC date and time. Leaving this unset does not create a timezone inferred from language.
help.system: Expression guidance only. Cannot override execution, privacy, approval or credential rules. Do not include secrets.

auth.title: A quieter control room.
auth.description: Manage your bot's runtime, group access and settings. Access is restricted to configured super administrators.
auth.expired: Your session expired. Private data has been cleared.
auth.loggedOut: You are signed out. Private data has been cleared.
auth.reopen: Close and reopen this Mini App to sign in again.
auth.openTelegram: Browser sign-in is not configured. Open a private chat with this bot in Telegram, send /webui, and open the Mini App.
auth.logoutHelp: This ends the current session and clears private data from this page.
auth.logoutFailed: Private data was cleared, but the server could not confirm logout. Close this page; the server session may remain valid until it expires.

state.reloadHelp: Reloading discards your edits and fetches the latest revision.
state.validation: Check the fields below before saving.

status.title: Runtime status
status.description: HTTP availability is not bot readiness. Each component reports its own state.
status.footnote: Current process only. No archived statistics or raw server logs are loaded.

groups.title: Group access
groups.description: Only explicitly authorized groups can use the bot. Telegram group administrators cannot grant this access.
groups.emptyHelp: Authorize a group by its Telegram chat ID or use /addgroup in Telegram.
groups.revokeHelp: Access for {{target}} will be removed. The bot will attempt to notify and leave the group; failed delivery does not restore access.
groups.partial: Access was updated, but notifying or leaving the group could not be completed.
groups.invalidId: Enter a valid negative Telegram chat ID.

settings.title: Core settings
settings.description: Versioned business configuration, shared with Telegram commands. Startup credentials are never exposed here.
settings.defaultLanguageHelp: Used for shared group notices and as the final language fallback.
settings.restartPending: Saved changes are waiting for a restart. The currently effective values are shown below.
settings.secretSet: A value is configured. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.secretHelp: The stored value will be removed when you save. This cannot be undone here.
settings.secretMasked: Enter a new value, not a masked placeholder.

modules.title: Native modules
modules.description: Only explicitly registered TypeScript modules appear here.
modules.emptyHelp: Only registered native modules appear here. Archived Python modules are not loaded and cannot be activated from this interface.
modules.name: Module
modules.aliasDescription: Native command-alias module, managed with /alias in Telegram private chat. No settings form is available here.
modules.stickerDescription: Convert stickers or download original pack ZIPs with /sticker in Telegram private chat, without administrator privileges. No web upload or settings form.

preferences.title: Personal preferences
preferences.description: Your language choice is shared between Telegram and this dashboard.
preferences.languageHelp: Automatic follows your verified Telegram language or browser language, then the instance default.
preferences.menuPending: Language saved, but Telegram's command menu could not be synchronized. Save again to retry.
